mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (login_id, nickname, password_hash, status) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{nickname}, #{passwordHash}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, nickname, password_hash, status, CAST(last_login_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_login_at, CAST(created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at, CAST(updated_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, login_id, nickname, password_hash, status, CAST(last_login_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_login_at, CAST(created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at, CAST(updated_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS updated_at FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND status != 'deleted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND status != 'deleted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE nickname = #{nickname} AND status != 'deleted'
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
